');
  background-position:center top;background-size:cover;background-repeat:no-repeat;
  filter:none;opacity:1;transform:translateZ(0)
}

/* Master charcoal brand header; the photograph remains a background, not a panel fill. */

}
/* Outer surfaces match master final subtle-glass override. */
.p5-si-card,.card,.match-center,.leaderboard-card,.stage1-controls,.roster-registration-list,.setup-card{
  background:linear-gradient(145deg,rgba(35,49,62,.75),rgba(15,26,37,.73))!important;

}

.match-center .court,.court{

  border-color:rgba(206,190,169,.25)!important;

}

  -webkit-backdrop-filter:blur(10px) saturate(112%)!important
}
/* Team showdown scoreboard uses master frosted glass instead of a venue-photo insert. */
.club-board{

  border-color:rgba(206,190,169,.25)!important;

   Tablet/desktop: one italic line. Phone: two italic right-aligned lines.

.showdown-confirm-dialog{background:linear-gradient(150deg,#223241,#13212d);border:1px solid rgba(210,176,124,.48);border-radius:18px;padding:25px;width:min(100%,460px);box-shadow:0 20px 80px #0009;color:#eee7db}
.showdown-confirm-overline{font-size:10px;letter-spacing:.15em;color:#d0b18d;font-weight:750}
.showdown-confirm-dialog h2{font-size:22px;line-height:1.3;margin:10px 0 10px;color:#f1e6d4}
.showdown-confirm-dialog p{font-size:14px;line-height:1.6;color:#bdc9d1;margin:0 0 22px}
.showdown-confirm-actions{display:flex;gap:9px;flex-wrap:wrap}
.showdown-confirm-actions button{flex:1 1 160px;min-height:50px;font-size:13px;line-height:1.3;padding:11px 13px;border-radius:10px;border:1px solid rgba(215,186,151,.36);background:rgba(255,255,255,.055);color:#eee6da;cursor:pointer;touch-action:manipulation}
.showdown-confirm-actions [data-confirm="yes"]{background:#9b695a;border-color:#c49585;color:#fff}
body.showdown-confirm-open{overflow:hidden}
@media(max-width:520px){.showdown-confirm-dialog{padding:21px 17px}.showdown-confirm-actions{flex-direction:column}.showdown-confirm-actions button{flex:0 0 auto;width:100%}}
@media print{.showdown-confirm-overlay{display:none!important}}


/* v0.8.7 — Compact mobile-safe initial setup / single scoring history */
.setup-simple-fields, .setup-simple-fields>.field, .setup-card .field{min-width:0;max-width:100%}
.setup-card #gameDate{display:block;width:100%!important;max-width:100%!important;min-width:0!important;inline-size:100%;max-inline-size:100%;min-inline-size:0;box-sizing:border-box;overflow:hidden; font-size:16px}
.setup-card #gameDate::-webkit-date-and-time-value{min-width:0;text-align:left}
.setup-card #matchFormat:invalid{color:#8c9ca8}
.setup-card #matchFormat option{color:#f4efe7}
/* Short, single-row, swipeable round selector (no multi-row stack of 22+ buttons) */
.match-center .round-selector{display:flex!important;flex-wrap:nowrap!important;overflow-x:auto!important;overflow-y:hidden!important;max-height:none!important;-webkit-overflow-scrolling:touch;overscroll-behavior-x:contain;touch-action:pan-x;gap:7px;padding:2px 2px 10px;scrollbar-width:thin}
.match-center .round-selector .round-chip{flex:0 0 38px;min-width:38px;height:38px}
.rounds-toggle{touch-action:manipulation}
/* Match History is the sole correction UI. Match list below the live courts is removed. */
.history-result-area{display:flex;align-items:center;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:8px}
.history-result-area button{touch-action:manipulation;min-height:31px;padding:5px 10px;font-size:11px}
.history-inline-editor{display:flex;align-items:end;gap:8px;flex-wrap:wrap;width:100%;padding:7px 0 2px}
.history-inline-editor>label{flex:0 1 120px;max-width:calc(50% - 20px);min-width:86px;font-size:10px;letter-spacing:.01em;line-height:1.3;color:#d7b68a}
.history-inline-editor>label input{display:block;width:100%;min-width:0;margin-top:5px;min-height:41px;padding:7px;font-size:19px;border:1px solid #7f735e;background:#182632;color:#fff;text-align:center;border-radius:8px}
.history-inline-editor>span{align-self:center;font-size:18px;color:#d9c9b5}
.history-edit-actions{display:flex;gap:8px;flex-wrap:wrap;flex:1 1 100%;padding-top:5px}
.history-inline-editor .history-edit-actions button{min-height:40px;flex:0 0 auto;font-size:12px;padding:8px 16px}
@media(max-width:700px){.setup-simple-fields{grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr)}.setup-card .field{width:100%}.setup-card #gameDate{width:100%!important}.rounds-drawer{padding:10px}.match-center .round-selector .round-chip{flex-basis:39px;min-width:39px}}

/* v0.8.8 · iOS Safari-safe date picker and truly unselected match format */
.setup-simple-fields > .field {min-width:0!important;max-width:100%!important;}
.setup-card .p5-date-shell {
 box-sizing:border-box!important;
 display:block!important;position:relative!important;
 height:48px;min-height:48px;
 width:100%!important;max-width:100%!important;min-width:0!important;
 overflow:hidden!important;border-radius:10px;
 isolation:isolate;
}
.setup-card .p5-date-display {
 position:absolute;inset:0;
 box-sizing:border-box;width:100%;max-width:100%;min-width:0;
 display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;gap:9px;
 padding:0 14px;border:1px solid #526a7d;border-radius:10px;
 background:#0c1c2b;color:#8696a5;
 font-size:16px;letter-spacing:0;
 pointer-events:none;overflow:hidden;z-index:0;
}
.setup-card .p5-date-shell.has-date .p5-date-display {color:#f4efe7}
.setup-card .p5-date-display>span {min-width:0;overflow:hidden;white-space:nowrap;text-overflow:ellipsis}
.setup-card .p5-date-display>svg {flex:0 0 19px;color:#cab18d}
.setup-card .p5-date-shell:focus-within .p5-date-display {border-color:#bb9465;box-shadow:inset 0 0 0 1px #bb9465}
/* Invisible real date control captures the full touch hit area; its native intrinsic
   minimum width never participates in the layout, including on iOS Safari. */
.setup-card .p5-date-shell > input#gameDate {
 -webkit-appearance:none!important;appearance:none!important;
 display:block!important;position:absolute!important;
 inset:0!important;left:0!important;right:0!important;top:0!important;bottom:0!important;
 margin:0!important;padding:0!important;
 width:100%!important;max-width:100%!important;min-width:0!important;
 height:100%!important;min-height:0!important;max-height:100%!important;
 border:0!important;border-radius:0!important;
 opacity:0!important;cursor:pointer!important;
 z-index:2;box-sizing:border-box!important;
}
.setup-card .p5-date-shell > input#gameDate::-webkit-calendar-picker-indicator {
 position:absolute!important;inset:0!important;
 width:100%!important;height:100%!important;
 margin:0!important;padding:0!important;opacity:0!important;
 cursor:pointer!important;
}
.setup-card #matchFormat:has(option:checked[value=""]) {color:#8696a5!important;}
@media(max-width:700px){.setup-card .p5-date-shell{height:46px;min-height:46px}}

/* v0.8.9: separate fixed-partner name inputs and explicit pair-count selection. */
.p5-dual-pair-row{display:grid;grid-template-columns:27px minmax(0,1fr) minmax(0,1fr);gap:10px;align-items:center;min-width:0;margin:0 0 11px}
.p5-dual-pair-row .p5-pair-index{align-self:center}
.master-roster-card .p5-dual-pair-row input,.roster-group .p5-dual-pair-row input{
 width:100%;min-width:0;max-width:100%;min-height:47px;padding:10px 11px;
 border:1px solid #63717d;border-radius:9px;background:rgba(16,25,34,.94);color:#f0e8dd;font-size:14px;
}
.p5-dual-pair-row input:focus{border-color:#d4b48a;outline:2px solid #d4b48a4d;outline-offset:1px}
.setup-card .format-summary{grid-template-columns:repeat(4,minmax(0,1fr));gap:4px;padding:15px 7px}
.setup-card .format-summary b{font-size:clamp(16px,2.6vw,23px)}
.setup-card .format-summary small{font-size:9px;letter-spacing:.08em}
.pairs-selection-hint{margin:10px 2px 0;font-size:11px;color:#9baebb}
@media(max-width:700px){
 .p5-dual-pair-row{grid-template-columns:22px minmax(0,1fr) minmax(0,1fr);gap:7px}
 .master-roster-card .p5-dual-pair-row input,.roster-group .p5-dual-pair-row input{font-size:13px;padding:9px 8px;min-height:45px}
 .setup-card .format-summary{gap:3px;padding:12px 5px}
 .setup-card .format-summary b{font-size:17px}
 .setup-card .format-summary small{font-size:8px;letter-spacing:.05em}
}
@media(max-width:340px){.p5-dual-pair-row{gap:5px;grid-template-columns:17px minmax(0,1fr) minmax(0,1fr)}.master-roster-card .p5-dual-pair-row input{padding:8px 6px;font-size:12px}}


/* -------------------------------------------------------------------------
 v0.8.11 · MATCH CONTROL MASTER / restrained charcoal & champagne UI
 - monochromatic charcoal/graphite surfaces, not saturated navy
 - understated gold buttons/borders, original team accent colors retained
 - iPhone/iPad native inputs and all existing functionality left intact
------------------------------------------------------------------------- */

 --good:#b3d7bf;--danger:#e7aaa2;--blue:#33414c;
}

body{color:#eee9e1!important;background-color:#0c1118!important}

 background-image:linear-gradient(180deg,rgba(11,15,21,.87),rgba(10,14,20,.91) 48%,rgba(10,14,19,.94)),url('data:image/webp;base64,
